clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, a captured Ironforge Mountaineer is held beneath the Gallows' End Tavern. The Forsaken keep him bound for the Royal Apothecary Society's experiments.

Beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, an Ironforge Mountaineer is held far from Khaz Modan. While patrons drink above, the Royal Apothecary Society uses him to test its concoctions. Apothecary Johaan and his peers measure their developing plague against living Alliance bodies, testing how swiftly and painfully their toxins kill.
